Institution: Univ. PERUGIA, Perugia
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IMIS-01 Misure

This project aims at developing a framework enabling measurements based on quantified signals using few bits or even one-bit. It will address the problem of estimating the parameters of signals, such as amplitude, frequency, time-of-arrival, delays, noise magnitudes, based on their binary version or of a very low-resolution, coarse representation.
